verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any ecosystem of third-party or partner-built agent apps, such as an extensions gallery or partner marketplace, that Gemini CLI can integrate into workflows. The MCP server configuration items show generic tool-server client support. That capability belongs to a separate MCP-client story and does not count here as partner-built agent app integration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
